integrity: All theorem premises and displayed inversion formulas were reconstructed using analytic identities and standalone exact rational checks. Review is same-model only. Independent audit and independent validation have not been performed. Relevant original-literature comparisons leave documented residual risks.
scientific_limitations: Structural identifiability from exact joint repeated-count laws only; requires Poisson individual abundance, independent visit-level Poisson false counts, independent beta-distributed persistent per-individual detection propensities, common visit protocol, conditional detection independence and closed populations. No finite-sample stability, nonparametric identification, or general abundance-family result is established.
title: Four visits identify beta-heterogeneous abundance despite Poisson false detections
